name: PDPL Copilot - Privacy Policy Text Gap Checklist
warnings: This is not a certification of PDPL compliance. Missing policy text is not proof of legal violation.
Collection-time notices may be separate from the published privacy policy.
Article existence and English excerpts do not verify paragraph numbering or legal interpretation.
External publication timing and actual processing practices cannot be established from uploaded policy text.
The policy-text score does not assess whether separate collection-time notices were supplied.
Exact excerpts in legal_sources may be truncated; do not treat them as full official legal texts.

evaluation_rules.policy_text_checks: Evaluate text-based notice checks only, with supporting policy excerpts.
evaluation_rules.external_checks: Do not infer publication timing or availability from the uploaded policy; return needs_review.
evaluation_rules.conditional_checks: Return needs_review if applicability is unknown; not_applicable only with documented reason.
evaluation_rules.contextual_duties: Never count contextual duties or suggestions as mandatory privacy-policy gaps.
evaluation_rules.aggregation: Do not label a requirement missing solely because a collection notice might exist separately.
evaluation_rules.alternative_checks: For items with aggregation_rule=any_of, meeting one alternative is sufficient; do not double-count missing alternatives.
evaluation_rules.deduplicated_checks: Evaluate rights-exercise mechanism and capacity-specific notices only once.
evaluation_rules.scope_boundary: Only public privacy-policy text is evaluated; separately delivered collection notices and actual company practices are outside this assessment.
evaluation_rules.missing_rule: Missing means the assessed text lacks a relevant disclosure, not that the controller violated the law; where a separate notice may contain it, flag needs_review for legal compliance.
evaluation_rules.evidence_rule: Each covered or partially_covered finding must include an exact excerpt from the supplied policy and its location.
evaluation_rules.conditional_logic: Only evaluate conditional checks when condition is supported by policy text or team-provided context; otherwise needs_review.
evaluation_rules.any_of_logic: N12 is satisfied by an adequate retention period OR, when specifying a period is not possible, adequate criteria. Do not score both as separate mandatory gaps.
evaluation_rules.counting: Aggregate by requirement ID; multiple checks do not automatically count as separate legal gaps.
evaluation_rules.external_default: External checks are needs_review unless external evidence is separately provided; do not infer a failure from silence.
evaluation_rules.non_exhaustive: This is a review-ready editable text-analysis checklist, not an exhaustive legal compliance determination.
